name: Homemade Macaroni & Cheese with Bread Crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 375°F. Coat a large (9 x 13-inch) baking dish with butter.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheeses. Place in a medium bowl, along with spices, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese
1 (8 oz) block mozzarella cheese
1 tbsp salt
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, and add pasta and salt; stir for a few seconds. Cook until pasta reaches desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. When the pasta is done, drain in a colander, and return to the pot.
Meanwhile, preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add flour and cook, whisking frequently, for 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup butter, unsalted
⅓ cup all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Slowly pour milk into the pot, whisking constantly. Continue to cook, whisking frequently, until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Add cheese and spices to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the cheese to melt before adding the next handful. Whisk until cheese melts and sauce is smooth, 1-2 minutes.
Transfer cheese sauce to the pot with the pasta. Using a silicone spatula, stir to combine the mac & cheese.
Transfer mac & cheese to the baking dish; evenly scatter bread crumbs on top.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until sauce is bubbling at the edges, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 5-10 minutes.
